description: Game-agnostic features of one clip candidate, in this order. ClipCandidate.features is positional against this list and ClipCandidate.feature_schema names it. A value the producer cannot compute is NaN; the scorer replaces it with the training mean. Never reorder or reuse a name: add a new schema id instead.

features.name: heuristic_score
features.description: The clipper's heuristic score (0..1), so the model starts from today's ranking.

features.name: duration_s
features.description: Candidate length in seconds.

features.name: event_count
features.description: Game events merged into the candidate.

features.name: event_kinds
features.description: Distinct event names among them.

features.name: max_contribution
features.description: Largest weight x confidence of one event.

features.name: mean_contribution
features.description: Mean weight x confidence over the events.

features.name: event_density
features.description: Events per second of candidate.

features.name: peak_position
features.description: Where the peak sits in the candidate, 0 (start) to 1 (end).

features.name: motion_z
features.description: Mean whole-frame motion, z-scored against the session so far.

features.name: flash_z
features.description: Mean flash (luma jump) signal, session z-score.

features.name: red_edge_z
features.description: Mean red-edge (damage vignette) signal, session z-score.

features.name: hud_activity_z
features.description: Mean HUD-region activity, session z-score.

features.name: loudness_z
features.description: Mean loudness, session z-score.

features.name: onset_rate
features.description: Audio onsets per second.

features.name: scene_cuts
features.description: Scene cuts per second.

features.name: black_fraction
features.description: Share of frames that are black.

features.name: frozen_fraction
features.description: Share of frames that are frozen.

features.name: silent_fraction
features.description: Share of audio hops that are silent.

features.name: video_coverage
features.description: Share of the candidate with video signal frames.

features.name: audio_coverage
features.description: Share of the candidate with audio signal frames.

features.name: curve_mean
features.description: Mean of the clipper's excitement curve over the candidate.

features.name: curve_max
features.description: Maximum of the excitement curve over the candidate.

features.name: curve_above_high
features.description: Share of frames at or above the curve's active high threshold.

features.name: curve_peaks
features.description: Excitement-curve peaks inside the candidate.

features.name: curve_peak_max
features.description: Strength of the strongest curve peak.

features.name: event_confidence_mean
features.description: Mean confidence of the game events inside.

features.name: flux_z
features.description: Mean spectral flux, session z-score.

features.name: scene_cut_z
features.description: Mean scene-cut signal, session z-score.

features.name: loudness_z_max
features.description: Maximum loudness z-score over the candidate.

features.name: motion_z_max
features.description: Maximum motion z-score over the candidate.
